details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements logically follow one another without contradictions. The narrative progresses from revenue performance to profitability deterioration, then explains causes (factory shutdown, energy price surge), and finally covers balance sheet items and real estate developments. Explanations for financial changes (S8-S11) are consistent with the reported results (S5-S7, S14). No contradictions exist between statements, and the structure moves logically from performance to causes to financial position. While S10 references an event in late February affecting Q1 2026 results, this is plausible within the quarter context and doesn't create internal inconsistency. The summary forms a clear, logical whole without unnecessary repetition.
